issues.description: The UML in the problem statement marks getTotalNumberOfStudents() as public, but the reference implementation declares it as protected. This visibility mismatch can confuse students about the intended API and may prevent external code or tests from accessing the method as specified.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the getTotalNumberOfStudents() method public in the solution (change 'protected int getTotalNumberOfStudents()' to 'public int getTotalNumberOfStudents()') so it matches the UML and the expected public API. Alternatively, update the UML/problem statement to indicate protected visibility if that was intentional, but prefer making the method public to align with the rest of the public helper methods.
